const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');const pw=require('playwright'),{PNG}=require('pngjs');
const {launchOptions}=require('../../tools/verify/browser-engines.cjs');
const results=[];
async function shot(page,name){const b=await page.screenshot();fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,`lead-webkit-resize-s4-${name}.png`),b,{flag:'wx'});const p=PNG.sync.read(b);const i=(Math.floor(p.height/2)*p.width+Math.floor(p.width/2))*4;return{width:p.width,height:p.height,center:[...p.data.subarray(i,i+4)]};}
(async()=>{for(const engine of ['chromium','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch({...launchOptions(engine),headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:640,height:400}});await page.setContent(`<style>html,body{margin:0}canvas{width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block}</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><script>const c=document.querySelector('canvas');const gl=c.getContext('webgl2',{preserveDrawingBuffer:true});function draw(){if(c.width!==innerWidth)c.width=innerWidth;if(c.height!==innerHeight)c.height=innerHeight;gl.viewport(0,0,c.width,c.height);gl.clearColor(1,0,0,1);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);requestAnimationFrame(draw)}draw();</script>`);await page.waitForTimeout(120);const before=await shot(page,engine+'-before');await page.setViewportSize({width:480,height:320});await page.waitForTimeout(200);const after=await shot(page,engine+'-after');const gpu=await page.evaluate(()=>{const a=new Uint8Array(4);gl.readPixels(240,160,1,1,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,a);return{center:[...a],error:gl.getError(),lost:gl.isContextLost(),url:c.toDataURL().slice(0,40)};});await page.evaluate(()=>c.style.transform='translateZ(0)');await page.waitForTimeout(80);const promoted=await shot(page,engine+'-promoted');results.push({engine,browserVersion:browser.version(),before,after,gpu,promoted});await page.close();}finally{await browser.close();}}fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'lead-webkit-resize-control-s4.json'),JSON.stringify({executionChannel:'Lead',method:'REAL_BROWSER_NATIVE_WEBGL2_CONTROL',results},null,2),{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify(results));})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
